rule: Figures 1,3,4,5 are the same layout (gray half, arrow on white half, one black and one white oval side by side), only mirrored. Figure 2 has one big black circle instead of two ovals.
In figures 1,2,4,5 each black block has its white partner on the outer side, so black faces the centre. In figure 3 the black blocks sit on the outer side and white faces the centre.
